meta.name: react-expert
meta.description: Use when building React 18+ applications in .jsx or .tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Creates components, implements custom hooks, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and implements state management. Invoke for Server Components, Suspense boundaries, useActionState forms, performance optimization, or React 19 features.

copy.tagline: 构建 React 组件与自定义 Hook，处理渲染问题和旧代码迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 React 做前端开发，需要写组件、调渲染或改旧代码。
copy.tagline_en: Build React components and hooks, debug rendering issues, and migrate legacy code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing React apps and need help with components, rendering, and code migration.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude在React 18+项目中会用TypeScript开发：创建组件、实现自定义hooks、管理状态，调试渲染问题，把类组件迁移为函数式，并补测试。
howto.when: 当你在React 18+项目（如Next.js App Router、create-react-app）中开发，或要求处理Server Components等React 19特性时触发。

say.note: 会生成带表单状态和pending处理的组件代码

say.text: 把这段类组件改成函数式组件
say.note: 会重写为带hooks的组件并检查类型

say.text: 用TypeScript写一个带自定义hook的组件并写测试

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude uses TypeScript to develop React 18+ apps: creates components, implements custom hooks, manages state, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and adds tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building React 18+ apps in .jsx/.tsx files, Next.js App Router or create-react-app projects, and for Server Components, Suspense, or React 19 features.

say_en.text: Create a form using React 19's useActionState
say_en.note: Generates a component with form state and pending handling.

say_en.text: Convert this class component to a functional one
say_en.note: Rewrites it with hooks and checks types.

say_en.text: Write a TypeScript component with a custom hook and tests
say_en.note: Outputs component, hook, and test files.
